# Units

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Provides unit conversion utilities for measurements

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`Cm`](#cm): Converts centimeters to points
- [`Inch`](#inch): Converts inches to points
- [`Mm`](#mm): Converts millimeters to points
- [`Parse`](#parse): Parses a unit-suffixed length token - `"1in"`, `"10mm"`, `"2.5cm"`, `"72pt"` - into points.
- [`ToPoints`](#topoints): Converts a value from the specified unit to points
- [`TryParse`](#tryparse): Parses a unit-suffixed length token into points, returning `false` rather than throwing when the token is not well-formed.
